# Themes — how it works

[← All features](../README.md) · [Code walkthrough](CODE_WALKTHROUGH.md)

Settings → Theme. Each theme changes **colours and fonts**; every card in Settings is drawn **in its own theme**.

| Theme | Light / dark | Headings | Body | Accent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Organic** | follows the system, or forced | Caprasimo | Figtree | terracotta `#C67139`, olive `#7A8A5E` |
| **Cappuccino** | dark | DM Serif Display | Nunito | caramel `#D29B6C` |
| **AMOLED Black** | dark, pure black | Space Grotesk | Inter | orange `#FF6A3D`, mint `#3DDC97` |
| **Arctic** | light | Comfortaa | Lexend | blue `#2E77B0` |
| **Sahara** | light | Playfair Display | Karla | rust `#B4502A`, teal `#2E6670` |
| **Sakura** | light | Quicksand | Mulish | pink `#CF4F74` |

Organic follows the system brightness, or a choice you force in Settings ("Brightness (Organic)"). Fonts are bundled with the app (SIL Open Font License, see `assets/fonts/LICENSES.md`): nothing is downloaded.
